lyre.name: Lyre
lyre.standin_note: Plays a folk harp's samples: no lyre has been recorded under a CC0 or public-domain licence.

kit.name: Drum Kit
kit.standin_note: Ride: a suspended cymbal struck with a stick; VCSL has no ride cymbal of its own.

choir.name: Choir (Aahs / Oohs)
choir.standin_note: Plays the Organ samples with a soft start.

notes: Pitches are the sounding MIDI notes: VSCO names its cello, contrabass and horn samples an octave below how they sound, and numbers the organ's keys MIDI + 86 (manual 3 only). loop is the sustained stretch, in seconds, that long notes repeat with a crossfade.
